record.title: Evaluate the receive-frequency discriminator and revise the measurement gate
record.intent: Choose whether raw frequency qualification supports a new survey while preserving the failed survey.
requirements: Use the frozen600/571 candidate bands and three-record thresholds. Retain global searches, FFT diagnostic, residuals, amplitudes, range and both built-in readbacks; refuse unsupported or ambiguous attribution.

Distinguish received sampled frequency, source command, built-in measurement and independent physical frequency accuracy. The scope clock remains uncalibrated; do not infer an internal estimator implementation from fs/7 alone.

If one bounded continuation is justified, draft/admit/commit a new survey with explicit raw-frequency qualification. Do not retroactively relax the earlier survey or change software policy. Keep original matched-policy and absolute bandwidth gates open.
Commit/push the conclusion and reconcile the remaining time window; otherwise record the exact bench question and continue useful offline work.
acceptance: The retained evidence resolves or precisely preserves the frequency ambiguity and supports a scoped next decision.
